screener_description: PG Electroplast Limited (PGEL) is the flagship company of PG Group. While the PG Group had started its journey in 1977, PG Electroplast was formally set up in 2003 and is a leading, diversified Indian Electronic Manufacturing Service provider. It specializes in Original Design Manufacturing (ODM), Original Equipment Manufacturing (OEM) and Plastic Injection Molding, catering to 50+ leading Indian and Global brands. [1]
